gap: No result ChatGPT got states that BLUETTI's store sells no single SKU holding the Apex 300, B300K battery, SolarX 4K solar controller and Home Integration Kit together, so the cheapest one-cart whole-house solar set is the Apex 300 + B300K + SolarX 4K bundle ($3,099) plus the $699 Home Integration Kit for $3,798; the home-backup bundle plus SolarX comes to $3,898. That set needs a panel string of at least 150 V to feed the SolarX 4K, and the Apex 300 is listed to ship only in late January.
standout_why: watthourlab.com (cited) lists transfer devices for the EcoFlow DELTA Pro 3, Anker F3800 Plus and Jackery 5000 Plus and their L14-30 outlets, but gives no prices or bundles, no BLUETTI kit and no solar-controller voltage window. popularmechanics.com (cited) blocked my fetch, so I could not check it. ChatGPT's answer says only that integration hardware 'can add substantially to the cost'. None of the results I read prices a one-store cart, compares bundle and separate prices, or flags the 150–500 V SolarX string requirement or the late-January ship date.
kit_items: power station: BLUETTI Apex 300 (2,764.8 Wh, 3,840 W). BLUETTI says one unit powers 120 V and 240 V devices at the same time, so a single unit can feed a 240 V well pump or AC circuit.
expansion battery: BLUETTI B300K, which brings the set to 5,529.6 Wh. It is sold only inside bundles at the prices I checked.
solar controller: BLUETTI SolarX 4K (up to 4 kW, takes 150–500 V panels). BLUETTI's page footnotes that the Apex 300's 4,000 W solar figure 'Requires a SolarX 4K'.

home connection: BLUETTI Apex 300 Home Integration Kit (single-unit version). BLUETTI says it ties the station to home circuits with 0 ms UPS or 20 ms switchover. Install by a licensed electrician, as watthourlab and OSHA advise.
solar panels: enough panels in series to reach the SolarX 4K's 150 V minimum. I did not verify a specific panel's Voc.

carts.bundle_sku: No SKU holds all four items. Closest: 'Apex 300 + B300K + Home Backup Kit (Single Apex 300)' $3,199 (https://www.bluettipower.com/products/apex-300-b300k-home-backup-kit-single-apex-300). It beats Apex 300 + B300K $2,599 + kit $699 = $3,298 by $99, but adding SolarX 4K ($699) brings it to $3,898, versus $3,798 for the SolarX bundle + kit. Use the SolarX bundle + kit. The 'Apex 300 + SolarX 4K' bundle ($2,199) costs $1 more than its parts ($1,499 + $699), so it is not worth using. Store-wide Black Friday early access (Nov 5–18): $100 off at $3,000+, $150 off at $4,000+. A free kid's T-shirt is listed with the bundle.
